speaker: Boy's mother
original_jp: 教えて下さい！ バルバロッサ様が処刑されるというのは本当なのですか！？
original_en:
I want to know the truth! Is King Barbarossa
really going to be executed?

speaker: Dipan Soldier
original_jp: …とにかく 早く地下道を通ってソルデへ逃げなさい <PART> 民が無事でいる事それが王の望みなのですよ
original_en:
...Just take the underground path
and head for refuge in Solde! <PART>
---
The king's orders are for his citizens'
safety!

speaker: Dipan Soldier
original_jp: 王女を亡くされてから 王は変わった支配者たる神を厭い 人の手による楽〓を作ると… <PART> だが その想いの未〓がこれだもし今王女が居たら 何と仰るのだろうか…
original_en:
After the princess's death, the king sought
to punish the gods and build a paradise. <PART>
---
But look where that got him...
What would the princess say?

speaker: Matron
original_jp: 恐ろしい…一体ワシらはどうなってしまうのじゃろう
original_en:
It's absolutely terrifying.
What in heavens will become of us? <PART>
---

speaker: Boy's mother
original_jp: さっき聞こえたざわめき…悲〓…まさか… そんなまさか！
original_en:
I heard voices...screams...
It can't be! It just can't be!

speaker: Dipan Soldier
original_jp: …我々は 王の命〓に従い民を誘導する〓務がある…！
original_en:
We must obey the king's orders,
and lead the people to safety!

speaker: Matron
original_jp: 王は… バルバロッサ王はどうなされたんだい？マルベス王妃は無事なのかい？
original_en:
What has happened to King Barbarossa?
And what of Queen Malabeth?

speaker: Merchant
original_jp: またのご利用 心よりお待ち申しております！
original_en: I look forward to our next meeting!

speaker: Merchant
original_jp: ディパンからは 見事に人が消えてしまいましたねこれぞ忘失都〓…と言うところですか <PART> そんな中 現れた貴方はまさに救世主！ささ どうぞ見て行って下さいな
original_en:
It's remarkable how barren it is here.
Dipan's nothing but a lost city now. <PART>
---
And you've appeared like some savior!
Please, won't you have a look?

speaker: Merchant
original_jp: いらっしゃいませ！旅から旅への行〓人でごさいます
original_en:
Come one, come all!
The traveling salesman is here to serve!

speaker: Boy's mother
original_jp: 嘘よ…こんなの信じない…悪い夢なんだわ そう！ そうに決まっ…て…
original_en:
It's not real... I'm imagining things.
It's a nightmare... Yes, that must be it...

speaker: Matron
original_jp: ディパンは…どうなるんだい？私達に…これからどうしろって言うんだい！
original_en:
What's going to happen to Dipan?
What are we supposed to do now!?

speaker: Dipan Soldier
original_jp: …我々は 王の望みを…民を無事誘導する事を最優先とします
original_en:
The king's orders to lead the people
to safety are our highest priority.

speaker: Dipan Soldier
original_jp: これが…神に逆らった未〓か…
original_en: So this is the price for opposing the gods.

speaker: Dipan Soldier
original_jp: 我々は… 王の命〓によりここを離れるわけにはいきません <PART> 民の安全を確保しない限り…何があろうと 王の命に背くわけには…
original_en:
We are forbidden to leave here
by order of the king. <PART>
---
Until the safety of the people is assured,
we must abide by the king's orders...
